title: Visualizing Functions using ggplot2
text:
This is the first post in a Quarto blog. Welcome!



We are going to make this



library(ggplot2)

Let’s say the function is: \[ Y = -7x^2 + 2x  \]
The we write it in such a way that R understands.

f <- function(x){
         -x^3+5*x^2-x
}

Then generate data set based in the function

x <- seq(from = 0, to = 17, by = 0.1)



df <- data.frame(x = x,
                 y = f(x))

df |> ggplot(aes(x, y)) + 
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "blue") + 
        theme_bw()
